axis: not easily moved from a purpose → immovably fixed on it whatever the cost

members.tone: The evenest word here - determination as a level that never dips, without the hardness *firm* and *stiff* put into it.
Resolution felt as something pressed against and not giving - resistance where *steady* offers only constancy.
Unshakable, but by rigidity - the resolve reads as unbending as much as strong.
The warmest of the unshakable four - firmness praised as something held faithfully over time.
Says the will outright and says there is a lot of it, with none of the hardness metaphor carried by *firm* or *stiff*.
Determination pushed to its extreme edge, where the resolve looks driven rather than chosen.
Hearty approval - dependable in the way something sturdy is, solid enough to take weight.
States only that the purpose is fixed and passes no verdict on it, where *steadfast* and *stalwart* praise.
Dependability raised to staunchness - stronger praise than *stout*, and it suggests standing by as well as standing up.
The purpose holds against something that might have cowed it - it implies the attempt was made and failed.
The flat negative of the same idea - the purpose simply did not move, without the note of fear faced down in *undaunted*.
Formal and settled, and it covers belief as well as purpose - firmness treated as a standing quality of the person, not a stand taken once.
